_note: Story 044, 063: the salon menu (pretend money, shown to the client and rung up at checkout; the wallet still gets only the tip). Story 063: a real 2026 US salon menu in four groups (Manicure 1-3, Pedicure 4-6, Nail enhancements 7-10, Add-ons 11-16), numbered in one list, each with a small drawn icon. Basic / Mid / Fancy scale the prices; Mid is about the 2026 medians (Zenoti, ThePricer, Boulevard: basic mani $25-45, gel $35-70, dip $40-60, acrylic full set $45-75, fill $30-50, French +$5-25, art +$5-20, removal +$10-25, pedicure $25-40+). tag: what the item is, so her order can be found on any menu (the older tags fullSet, ombre, gems, extensions still work on a player's own menu). limits: the player's own menu. Story 069: Combos (17-18), priced from 2026 US guides: a basic mani-pedi combo is about $50-70 and a gel combo $70-110, with bundles typically 10-25% cheaper than the two services separately (usecalcpro.com/health/mani-pedi-cost-calculator, groupon.com/articles/what-is-a-pedicure-guide-to-cost-tips-and-types, zenoti.com/thecheckin/nail-salon-prices, joinblvd.com/blog/nail-salon-prices, thepricer.org/cost-of-manicures-and-pedicures). Each combo here saves about 12% against its two items on the same price set. Story 071: pedicure add-ons from real menus (Groupon pedicure guide 2026; places.singleplatform.com/diamond-nails--spa/menu; sites.google.com/view/modernnailsspa/services/pedicure; sites.google.com/view/phoenix-nails-spa/service-menu/pedicure-services): gel polish on any pedicure +$10-15, callus treatment, hot stones +$8. Story 071: each main service shows what it includes ("includes", en/vi) under its name, from the same sources and the Groupon pedicure guide 2026: a classic pedicure is soak, trim and shape, cuticle care, callus removal, a short massage and polish (~$35-50); a spa/deluxe pedicure adds a sugar or sea-salt scrub, a mask, paraffin or hot towels and a longer foot and calf massage (~$50-80). A player's own menu keeps its own items (no includes).
